title: Boots on Broadway with Pool  .7 Miles to Downtown
description:
Welcome to Boots on Broadway at the Hyve!
 
Featuring lux furnishings, this space is the perfect downtown spot. It features 3 bedrooms and a queen sleeper sofa, sleeping 10 guests. There is a fully equipped kitchen including a Keurig coffee bar (stocked with a start supply of k-pods). Both the living and bedrooms offer Smart TV’s and high-speed internet. Enjoy free parking (first come first served), on-site gym, pool and courtyard, and so much more. Just .7 miles to Broadway!

The space
When you arrive at Boots on Broadway, you will feel the heart of the Music City throughout the unit. There are custom decorations in all of the bedrooms, 6-person dining table plus 4-person eat in kitchen island, super comfortable sofa bed, Smart TV, fireplace, and more in the living room- make sure you snap a photo under the Boots on Broadway neon sign! Visit the Honky Tonks on Broadway with a short 15-minute walk, quick Uber/Lyft ride, or even a scooter. Grab dinner at one of the many great restaurants close by. With so much to do both at the condo and in close proximity, this is bound to be a trip to remember!
 
Sleeping Accommodations:
Primary Bedroom: 1 King Bed with en-suite bathroom
Bedroom Two: 1 King Bed
Bedroom Three: 2 Queen Beds
Living Room: 1 Queen Size Sleeper Sofa

Condo Amenities: 
This condo is fully stocked to make your stay easy, comfortable, and truly feel like home. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, a Keurig coffee maker with complimentary K-cups, and everything you need to prepare full meals or quick snacks. The bathrooms are outfitted with plush, high-quality linens and complimentary shampoo, conditioner, and body wash, along with a hairdryer and iron/ironing board for your convenience. We provide starter supplies including trash bags, dishwasher pods, toilet paper, and toiletries, so you can settle in right away. You’ll also find pool towels, generous closet space, and extra bedding. A private washer and dryer with laundry pods/dryer sheets included makes longer stays effortless and stress-free.

If you are parking a car during your stay, you will have 3 options:
-Owner/Guest Garage - this is a FREE first come, first serve garage that requires the Door app for access. You will receive Door access about 3 days prior to arrival. EV Chargers available. 
-Street Parking - this is FREE first come, first serve parallel street parking
-Lower-Level Garage - this is a paid public parking garage that has direct elevator access right to your condo floor. Discounted pricing is available for people staying at one of our condos.

Please note:
- Arriving ahead of check in time? The Hyve offers complimentary luggage storage! Please check with us for hours.
- All common areas and amenities like the pool, cabanas, gym, workspace lounge, lobby, etc. are managed by the building. We do not have control over the working conditions of equipment, maintenance, or availability.
- This is a condo located in downtown Nashville. As pictured, this development sits near train tracks. We have provided a white noise machine and ear plugs for your convenience. As Nashville continues to grow, nearby construction is common and may be present during your stay. If you are sensitive to noise, this may not be the best location for your stay. Like any urban location, the presence of unhoused individuals may be experienced.
- The pool will be closed during the winter and reopens March-October seasonally.

Guest Access/Building Amenities: 
Guests will have access to the entire unit, with the exception of the owner’s supply closet. Enjoy the heated outdoor pool with cabanas, which is open from March through October between 7 a.m. and 10 p.m. Additional shared amenities in the courtyard include an outdoor gas grill and kitchen area, a ping pong table located outside by the pool deck, plenty of outdoor seating, and fire pits. Inside, there's a state-of-the-art gym featuring Peloton equipment. Working during your visit? Ample space in the workspace and community lounge,  which features a TV, vending machine, couches, and tables, ideal for casual meetings or remote work. On-site security provides added peace of mind throughout your stay. 

Walkable to all the things!
From this location, you can easily walk to some of Nashville’s most popular spots, including City Winery, Bad Axe Throwing, Third Man Records & The Blue Room, and convenient Party Bus and Pedal Tavern pick-up locations. You’re also steps from Yee-Haw Brewery, Ole Smoky Distillery, and Tennessee Brew Works, as well as major attractions like Music City Center (the convention center), the Country Music Hall of Fame, and Bridgestone Arena. 
 
Both Upper Broadway and Lower Broadway are within walking distance (just .7 miles), giving you quick access to legendary honky-tonks and venues such as Tootsies, The Stage, Hard Rock, Jason Aldean’s, Luke Bryan’s, Kid Rock’s, Morgan Wallen's This Bar, Ole Red, Jelly Roll’s Goodnight Nashville, Luke Comb’s Category 10, Posty’s, and many more. The iconic Ryman Auditorium is also just a short walk away, along with Fifth and Broad featuring Assembly Food Hall and tons of shopping and eateries.
 
Short Uber ride to:
If you want to explore a little farther, you’re only a short Uber ride from Nissan Stadium, the Grand Ole Opry, and Opry Mills Outlet Mall, making it easy to catch a game, see a show, or enjoy some shopping.
 
Ask us about exclusive perks for Hyve guests! When you stay at Hyve, you get access to exclusive discounts on some of Nashville’s best experiences, all right within the building or just steps away. Rotating seasonal offers and new partnerships throughout the year.
 
If you have any questions at all about this property, please reach out to us. We would love the opportunity to host you and share a bit of our city with you!

Presented by Injoy Nashville: Experience Your Stay, Design by Injoy Vacations
